cv.name: Lotte Lammers
cv.headline: Accountancy graduate | Bookkeeping, VAT and year-end support
cv.summary: Final-year accountancy student finishing a graduation internship at a mid-sized accounting firm. Hands-on with bookkeeping, VAT returns and year-end files for SME clients, and keen to continue as an assistant accountant.

experience.title: Graduation Intern – Assistant Accountant
bullets: Prepare year-end files and draft financial statements for 15 SME clients under Dutch GAAP
Process bank statements and purchase invoices in Exact Online and Twinfield
Prepare quarterly VAT returns (btw-aangifte) for review by the senior
Writing my graduation thesis on automating bank reconciliations for small clients

experience.title: Part-time Bookkeeping Assistant
bullets: Bookkeeping and invoicing for freelancers and small shops, around 12 hours per week

education.details: Final semester: graduation internship; expected graduation February 2027
